title: Data
cacheBusy: Stop playback before clearing the cache.
recordingBusy: Apply or discard the current recording in the recording workspace before restoring or moving your data.
name: Name

hints.launchOnStartup: Run the application when you log in to your computer.
hints.silentStartup: Stay in the system tray when launched at login. Opening the application manually still shows its window.
hints.autoCheckUpdates: Check for new versions at startup and during use. Installation still requires confirmation.
hints.backupIntervalHours: Set to 0 to turn off automatic backups.
hints.backupKeep: Remove the oldest backups when this limit is reached.
hints.logsEnabled: Save application activity to help diagnose problems.
hints.logLevel: Use Information normally, or Debug when investigating an issue.

locations.title: Storage location
locations.description: Songs, playlists, templates and projects are saved in the application data directory.
locations.migrateDescription: Application data will move to the selected directory. The application will restart when finished.
locations.defaultDescription: Move current data back to the default directory and replace existing application data there. The application will restart when finished.
locations.restartRequired: Data has changed. Restart the application to continue.
locations.repairRequired: The operation could not finish. Restart to repair your data.

archive.title: Export and import
archive.description: Save a complete copy of your data, or restore a backup file.
archive.cloudRestoreDescription: Restore saved songs, playlists, templates and projects only. Current drafts will be kept in the local backup created before restoring, rather than applied over the restored data. The application will restart when finished.
archive.restoreDescription: Current songs, playlists, templates, projects and drafts will be replaced by this backup. A copy of current data will be kept before restoring, then the application will restart.

backup.title: Local backups
backup.description: Keep regular data snapshots, or create one whenever you need.
backup.deleteDescription: This backup will be permanently deleted. Current application data will remain available.

cloud.title: Cloud sync
cloud.description: Connect your own cloud storage to transfer data snapshots between devices.
cloud.autoUploadConfirmDescription: Changes to saved local data will replace the cloud snapshot for this profile. Changes from other devices will not be downloaded or merged automatically.
cloud.autoUploadHint: Upload local changes automatically. Restoring cloud data always requires your confirmation.
cloud.secretCleared: Credentials will be cleared when saved
cloud.savedButConnectionFailed: Configuration saved, but the connection failed
cloud.switchDescription: Switching will disable the current sync service. Check and save the new configuration before enabling it again.
cloud.discardDescription: Your cloud sync changes have not been saved and will be discarded when you close settings.
cloud.uploadDescription: Upload songs, playlists, templates and saved projects, replacing the existing cloud snapshot. Unsaved drafts and device preferences stay on this device.
cloud.noRemoteSnapshot: No cloud snapshot exists yet. This will create the first one.
cloud.noSnapshot: No cloud snapshot is available to restore.
cloud.operationBusy: Wait for the current operation to finish, or cancel sync first.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.clearCacheHint: Clear the online catalog and preview cache while keeping local songs and projects.
maintenance.clearCacheDescription: The online catalog will be downloaded again when you next visit. Local data will remain available.
maintenance.resetPreferencesHint: Restore default editor display, layout, zoom and recording options.
maintenance.resetDescription: Interface preferences will return to their defaults. Songs, projects, templates, drafts and cloud configuration will be kept.

about.description: MIDI library, editing and auto performance
